nodes.label: Two ticks per round
nodes.scope: Natural numbers, including zero; the counter starts at zero and adds two per round.
nodes.idea: Use induction: both sides start at zero. In the successor case, substitute the induction hypothesis into $T(n)+2$ and use the doubled-successor identity backwards.

nodes.label: Substitute the induction hypothesis
nodes.scope: The induction hypothesis holds for this n; it is not an additional hypothesis of the final theorem.
nodes.role: The successor case of the enclosing induction; a curated subargument inside the theorem, not a separate Lean declaration.
nodes.idea: $T(n+1)=T(n)+2=(n+n)+2=(n+1)+(n+1)$. The middle equality applies the function $k↦k+2$ to the induction hypothesis. The last equality reverses the arithmetic bridge.

nodes.label: Unfold one round
nodes.role: The first equality of the successor calculation.
nodes.idea: The successor equation is the defining clause of Counter.ticks. This branch stops at that definition; no claim card is supplied for the explicit-binder lemma.

nodes.label: Regroup the doubled successor
nodes.role: The final equality of the successor calculation.
nodes.idea: Regroup $n+1+n+1$ as $n+n+1+1$. The source proves the identity with omega; this explanation stops at elementary addition, not at the internals of that tactic.
